profiles.source: shipped default: the adopted pancake flags that are ported to this branch (ledger ids from pancake-strata TEST_LEDGER.md), minus every flag the 2026-11-19 box measurements of this branch found FAIL / NO-GAIN / UNSUPPORTED (except the text-identity UNSUPPORTED of the three RDNA kernels and of STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING, restored by owner decision 2026-11-20) or lossy without a passing gate (top-level "removed", owner order 2026-11-19 23:05); regenerate with tools/pancake/flag_diag.sh --write-recommended after the box benchmark

flags.name: STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING
flags.ledger: T-096 (11.7K-token prompt 1,345 -> 1,850-1,920 tok/s, provisional, noisy machine); restored 2026-11-20 (pancake TEST_LEDGER.md T-991..)
flags.exactness: EXACT-UNVERIFIED on this model (owner decision 2026-11-20): it was removed only for 'claimed exact but the text differs' (diag rerun, plain build), which the owner ruled invalid here because plain upstream against itself (base-late) also gave DIFFERENT text in every run of 2026-11-19
flags.runtime_note: on the box's ROCm 10.0 the hipBLASLt runtime is version 100401, so this table is the one that matches (engine log: 'prefill gemm: hipBLASLt tuning enabled (43 rows, gfx1100, version 100401)'); a 100200 table (Strata-rdna3's setups) is refused there ('hipBLASLt version mismatch: file=100200 runtime=100401; using hipBLASEx'). The engine checks the header and ignores a mismatching table, so other ROCm versions fall back safely

flags.name: STRATA_RDNA_Q6K
flags.ledger: T-079 (microbench), T-081 (confirm edit +4.3% +-5.0, text identical; inside noise), T-009
flags.exactness: EXACT-UNVERIFIED on this model (owner decision 2026-11-20): the diag's 'claimed exact but the text differs' is not a verdict here, because plain upstream against itself (base-late) also gave DIFFERENT text in every run of 2026-11-19; exactness is judged by the parity ctests (rdna_mmvq_parity), not run on the box yet

flags.name: STRATA_GR_RDNA
flags.ledger: T-009 (RDNA kernel bundle: decode 87-101 -> 104-108 tok/s; 3.0 = 104 against 101, a bound for the bundle, not a per-flag number)
flags.exactness: EXACT-UNVERIFIED on this model (owner decision 2026-11-20): the diag's 'claimed exact but the text differs' is not a verdict here, because plain upstream against itself (base-late) also gave DIFFERENT text in every run of 2026-11-19; exactness is judged by the parity ctests (rdna_gr_parity), not run on the box yet

flags.name: STRATA_RDNA_MMVQ_WAVE
flags.ledger: T-009 (same bundle bound), T-072 (mode 1 is 4.5% slower than 3 on short)
flags.exactness: EXACT-UNVERIFIED on this model (owner decision 2026-11-20): the diag's 'claimed exact but the text differs' is not a verdict here, because plain upstream against itself (base-late) also gave DIFFERENT text in every run of 2026-11-19; exactness is judged by the parity ctests (none registered), not run on the box yet

removed.name: --lookup-max-t
removed.evidence: lossy (exact false); the quality gate of this branch did not pass: /home/dan/auto-runs/benchexact/gate-us (spec 222, 48 requests, token forcing against plain upstream v0.2.16): updated-exact (which keeps --lookup-max-t 12) REJECT on the rate rule, mismatch 3.379% against 1.562% / 1.360% for two stock runs, +1.92 points, 90% interval [+1.23, +2.74]; updated REJECT (3.964%, +2.50 points); event rule PASS for both. AGENTS.md: never lossy without a passing gate. The pancake-base PASS (T-126/T-127) does not carry over.

removed_note: Taken out of the gfx1100 profile 2026-11-20 (owner order 2026-11-19 23:05: remove what did not work): every flag with a FAIL / NO-GAIN / UNSUPPORTED verdict on this branch, and every lossy flag whose quality gate did not pass. Not measured as a single flag here and kept: --pcie-frac 0 (exact). Restored 2026-11-20 by owner decision: STRATA_RDNA_Q6K, STRATA_GR_RDNA, STRATA_RDNA_MMVQ_WAVE and STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING (100401 table) (their UNSUPPORTED came from text identity, which the default fails against itself on this model; the 100401 table also matches the ROCm 10.0 runtime). The specs 220-223 measure the whole updated preset (configs/pancake/flashnext-iq2_xs-updated-hip.json), not this file.
